{{Quote|Beurth Ogh, Gamorr.|Kandra Nilitz|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>}}
'''Beurth Ogh''' was a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Camera/Legends|camera]] operator who, alongside [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Kandra Nilitz]], who was on assignment for [[Landing Zone NewsNet]] at the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] [[Senate Building/Legends|Rotunda]] during the [[Plan Delta|Jedi coup of the Galactic Alliance]]. Ogh later joined Nilitz when she smuggled the [[Force psychosis|insane]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Jysella Horn|Jysella]] and [[Valin Horn]] off of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in exchange for an exclusive news story. After arriving on [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]], the Horns abandoned Kandra and Beurth. Beurth went with Kandra as she interviewed [[Snaplaunce]], the mayor of [[Hweg Shul]], who revealed that the [[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalkers]] could not have stabbed him as they had already taken off in his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], ''[[Vote Snaplaunce]]''. Kandra then sent communications to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to meet up with her in exchange for a ride. When the Skywalkers and [[Vestara Khai]] arrived, they were attacked by three [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], but the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Vestara were able to defeat them. In exchange for a ride, Luke told Kandra and Beurth about [[Abeloth]] and the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]].
